description: Assign a finding to an organisation member, or clear its assignment. Requires write permission. Assignment can notify the assignee by email and Slack and synchronise connected issue trackers. For several findings, use assign_findings. Someone who isn't on Odin yet (a finding's ownerNotOnOdin) can't be assigned until an owner or admin invites them in the web app.

assigneeUserId.description: Organisation member user ID, or null to clear assignment.

expectedAssigneeUserId.description: Only reassign if the current assignee is still this user ID (null for unassigned); otherwise Odin refuses with a conflict and nothing changes.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

name: assign_finding
title: Assign a finding
